name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0, the Data tab under touch: in the default sandbox as admin on a 375x812 phone with touch: the Data tab with a dry run's report shown and the detached list: no sideways scroll, every control, snapshot name and line of the report inside the screen; every button and field of the tab and of the list at least 44 px high; Restore…'s question inside the screen with every control at least 44 px; Cancel restores nothing and puts the focus back on Restore…. The snapshots are as before the run.

steps.name: the details probe in every document (its request log and server())
the served script is 1.0.2.0
steps.message: User Ratings 1.0.2.0 is not the script the page loaded

steps.name: before the run: the snapshots as the server holds them
steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots'); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('snapshots ' + r.status); } return r.json.Snapshots.map(s => s.Name).sort();

steps.name: the Data tab mounted: the snapshots, the users and the jobs read, and the detached list
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = __jfurDetails.requests.slice(window.__mark); const got = (p) => r.some(x => x.method === 'GET' && x.path === p && x.status === 200); return !document.querySelector('#UserRatingsData').classList.contains('hide') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-export') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDetachedListRoot .jfur-det') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Diagnostics') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Jobs') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Detached'); })()

steps.name: the time the lists take to draw
GETs only (and the page's own Detached/Seen): opening the tab writes nothing
no select in the Data tab or the detached list (the TV layout's D-pad and OK work on every control)
the sandbox has a snapshot to offer Restore… on
steps.message: no snapshot in the sandbox yet: run userratings-data-desktop.json (or any import) first

steps.name: phone: an export of the sandbox at once, through the API
steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Export'); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('export ' + r.status); } window.__jfurPhoneFile = JSON.stringify(r.json); return window.__jfurPhoneFile.length > 0;

steps.name: phone: it put in the file field
steps.script: const input = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-file'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([window.__jfurPhoneFile], 'userratings-export-phone.json', { type: 'application/json' })); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return input.files.length;

steps.name: phone: the layout as shown
steps.eval: (() => { const out = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsDataRoot *, #UserRatingsDetachedListRoot *')).filter(e => e.getClientRects().length > 0 && e.children.length === 0).filter(e => { const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.left < -1 || b.right > innerWidth + 1; }).map(e => e.className || e.tagName); return { width: innerWidth, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, body: document.body.scrollWidth, out, snapshots: document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-snapshot').length }; })()
